item.title: Rallying Cry – September 5, 2026
item.description: The King and Queen of the UK celebrated Scottish culture at the Braemar Gathering, while Erling Haaland scored again to lift Man City to the top of the Premier League, and Singapore’s air quality finally improved to safer levels.
